environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in EKS pod with Thales Luna Network HSM 7 (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). Logging is configured to emit to stdout which is captured by a Fluent Bit sidecar container running with a custom Lua filter plugin (log_sanitizer.lua) that applies RFC 5424 structured data encoding and strips control characters (0x00-0x1F, 0x7F) from all message fields before forwarding to OpenSearch. The Fluent Bit configuration uses the 'Modify' filter with condition 'Key_Value_Does_Not_Match' on the 'log' field against pattern '^[\x20-\x7E\s]*$' to quarantine entries containing injection characters to a separate dead-letter index. Pod runs with seccomp profile 'runtime/default' and the container filesystem is read-only. Network policy restricts egress to HSM endpoint (10.0.5.0/24:1792) and OpenSearch (vpc endpoint) only.

config.runtime: Python 3.9 in distroless container on EKS 1.28
config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7 (FIPS 140-2 L3) via PKCS#11
config.logging: stdout -> Fluent Bit sidecar with Lua sanitization filter
config.fluent_bit_filter: Lua script strips chars outside 0x20-0x7E range, RFC 5424 structured encoding
config.dead_letter_handling: Entries with control chars routed to quarantine index
config.container_security: read-only rootfs, seccomp runtime/default, non-root UID 65534
